svg.title: Qvidja: daily GPP, Reco and gap-filled NEE (g C m-2 d-1), air temperature, soil water content and precipitation from 2018-05-09 to 2025-12-31, with the recorded management events. A dashed line marks a second date of the same event in another source.
svg.desc: Four panels on one date axis (local time, UTC+2) from 2018-05-09 to 2025-12-31. 2794 days with gap-filled NEE; 1230 days with a measured fraction of NEE below 10 % are drawn lighter. Daily GPP from −1.5 to 17.6, Reco from 0.1 to 14.1 and NEE from −9.9 to 8.4 g C m-2 d-1 (NEE < 0 = uptake). 35 recorded events in the period (11 harvest, 6 cut, 5 grazing, 2 tillage, 1 sowing, 10 fertilisation), drawn as vertical lines with a type label above panel (a). Largest change of daily GPP near each event: harvest 2018-06-12: GPP drop on 2018-06-12 (0 d, clear); cut 2018-08-21: GPP drop on 2018-08-25 (+4 d, not clear); sowing 2018-09-03: GPP rise after sowing on 2018-09-19 (+16 d, not clear); harvest 2018-09-23: GPP drop on 2018-09-24 (+1 d, clear); harvest 2019-06-11: GPP drop on 2019-06-12 (+1 d, clear); harvest 2019-08-20: GPP drop on 2019-08-18 (−2 d, clear); harvest 2020-06-23: GPP drop on 2020-06-24 (+1 d, not clear); harvest 2020-08-28: GPP drop on 2020-08-28 (0 d, clear); tillage 2021-04-20: GPP drop on 2021-04-22 (+2 d, clear); harvest 2021-06-14: GPP drop on 2021-06-14 (0 d, clear); grazing 2021-08-23: GPP drop on 2021-09-03 (+11 d, clear); harvest 2022-06-21: GPP drop on 2022-06-22 (+1 d, not clear); grazing 2022-08-05: GPP drop on 2022-08-13 (+8 d, clear); cut 2022-09-09: GPP drop on 2022-09-13 (+4 d, not clear); harvest 2023-06-20: GPP drop on 2023-06-10 (−10 d, clear); harvest 2023-08-22: GPP drop on 2023-08-18 (−4 d, clear); tillage 2023-09-07: GPP drop on 2023-09-09 (+2 d, clear); harvest 2024-06-15: GPP drop on 2024-06-14 (−1 d, clear); cut 2024-07-18: GPP drop on 2024-07-14 (−4 d, not clear); cut 2024-08-09: GPP drop on 2024-07-31 (−9 d, not clear); grazing 2024-10-04: GPP drop on 2024-10-05 (+1 d, clear); grazing 2025-06-14: GPP drop on 2025-06-09 (−5 d, clear); grazing 2025-07-30: GPP drop on 2025-07-29 (−1 d, clear). Harvest 2018-09-23: the xlsx source gives 2018-09-25; the largest GPP drop is on 2018-09-24 (+1 d from the used date, −1 d from the other date), at the same distance from both dates. Harvest 2019-06-11: the xlsx source gives 2019-06-10; the largest GPP drop is on 2019-06-12 (+1 d from the used date, +2 d from the other date), nearer to the used date. Harvest 2019-08-20: the xlsx source gives 2019-08-21; the largest GPP drop is on 2019-08-18 (−2 d from the used date, −3 d from the other date), nearer to the used date. Fertilisation 2019-06-20: the article source gives 2019-06-26; no change-point test for this type. Fertilisation 2020-07-27: the xlsx source gives 2020-05-25; no change-point test for this type. Harvest 2020-06-23: the xlsx source gives 2020-06-11; the largest GPP drop is on 2020-06-24 (+1 d from the used date, +13 d from the other date), not clear. Harvest 2020-08-28: the xlsx source gives 2020-08-27; the largest GPP drop is on 2020-08-28 (0 d from the used date, +1 d from the other date), nearer to the used date. Harvest 2021-06-14: the xlsx source gives 2021-06-21; the largest GPP drop is on 2021-06-14 (0 d from the used date, −7 d from the other date), nearer to the used date. Grazing 2021-08-23: the xlsx source gives 2021-06-01; the largest GPP drop is on 2021-09-03 (+11 d from the used date, +94 d from the other date), nearer to the used date. Grazing 2022-08-05: the xlsx source gives 2022-06-01; the largest GPP drop is on 2022-08-13 (+8 d from the used date, +73 d from the other date), nearer to the used date. Grey bands: thermal growing season, 2018: n/a to 2018-11-18; 2019: 2019-04-16 to 2019-10-27 (194 d); 2020: 2020-05-01 to 2020-12-07 (220 d); 2021: 2021-05-10 to 2021-11-18 (192 d); 2022: 2022-05-05 to 2022-11-15 (194 d); 2023: 2023-04-17 to 2023-10-17 (183 d); 2024: 2024-04-27 to 2024-12-03 (220 d); 2025: 2025-04-13 to n/a.
